}, 350); } // simple IntersectionObserver for elements with [data-animation] const animEl = document.querySelectorAll("[data-animation]"); if (animEl && animEl.length) { const io = new IntersectionObserver( (entries) => { entries.forEach((entry) => { if (entry.isIntersecting) { const el = entry.target; const name = el.getAttribute("data-animation"); el.classList.add("animated", name); el.style.opacity = 1; io.unobserve(el); } }); }, { threshold: 0.15 } ); animEl.forEach((e) => { e.style.opacity = 0; io.observe(e); }); } // wire video play buttons const playBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".video--play--btn"); function onPlayClick(ev) { ev.preventDefault(); // for now show an embedded audio sample;
